name: Pagy
summary: Free no-code website builder: pick a template, arrange pre-designed blocks and publish in minutes.
description: A drag-and-drop website builder for personal sites, portfolios, landing pages, forms and company websites. Pages are assembled from ready-made blocks — cards, buttons, images, video, 3k+ icons, forms, maps, links and embedded tweets — and can start from ready-made templates. Free plan: 1 page with unlimited bandwidth; paid plans from $10/month add pages, contributors, custom domains, integrations and custom code.
